criteria.call: does the volume state machine beat buy-and-hold on 510300 after cost?

passes.beats_null: the phase-null p (share of shifts that match or beat it) < 0.05
passes.drawdown: max drawdown not worse than the benchmark's

criteria.execution: signal at close t, fill at open t+1, mark to close

deviations: primary index is summed traded VALUE (成交额) across the archive, not summed share counts (splits and universe drift break a share-count sum); the share-count leg is published beside it
universe = the 5,223-name A-share archive on disk (2020-01 ->), coverage per bar published as coverage_min/coverage_median
the source's short leg is dropped: an ETF book cannot short spot, so the whole 0.807..1.15 band is cash
verdict_reasons: phase null p=0.09 does not beat 5%
the two honest volume proxies disagree in sign (value -0.67pp/yr p=0.09 vs share-count +4.38pp/yr p=0.005), so the berth's own axis is the open question, not the rule
even the passing proxy gives the excess back at x3 cost (-6.11%/yr vs buy-and-hold -0.26%/yr)
